lines.text: Rate of change or gradient: differentiate. Area, total change or accumulation: integrate.
Max or min value: solve $f'(x)=0$, then test with $f''(x)$ or a sign change.
Product inside an integral and no substitution fits: try integration by parts.
A limit of the form $\tfrac00$ or $\tfrac\infty\infty$: L'Hôpital's rule.
